purpose: Continue the existing r1 visual-factual adapter using reviewed train-only 3-D RGB examples, without changing the flight policy or claiming action learning.
predeclared_quality_gates: Identical ordered parent/candidate holdout IDs and model-input SHA-256 values
Strict reply and full exact-match counts must not decrease
Visible true-positive and not-confirmed true-negative counts must not decrease in either val or test
At least one additional correct zero-visible-pixel holdout prediction
All navigation facts remain unknown for all 84 candidate holdout inputs
data_limitations: Known development render regression, not a new blind benchmark
Positive references are visible self-crops, not temporally tracked instance identity
Negative references are qualified train-only same-world and same-geometry crops, not identity proof
128 new train examples plus 26 original train replay examples
No action labels, Gazebo flight trajectory, physical data or execution authority
